title: Trip Itinerary — Build and Day-of
description: From trip creation to day-of navigation. Proves cross-vertical resolution: the SAME transversal core (SCard, ListItem, Chip, EmptyState, AIInsight) composes into a Travelz domain flow — no core changes needed.
trigger: A traveller creates or opens a trip itinerary.

mobile.rationale: The traveller is on the ground, one-handed, often offline (island connectivity). The itinerary is a reference, not a form — glanceable times, transport chips, one tap to act.

desktop.rationale: Building the itinerary is desktop work: drag stops, compare transport, see the whole week.

tablet.rationale: Couple or family planning together; also presentation to a partner.

steps.purpose: Open the trip; show the next day's plan.
steps.rule: Next activity is the hero. Times in mono. Offline: full itinerary cached, 'synced 2h ago' indicator.
Transport type as chips between stops. Times in mono. A day with no plans shows empty-state: 'Nothing planned — add an activity or explore.'

steps.purpose: One stop: what, when, how to get there.
steps.rule: AI suggestions (nearby alternatives) use AIInsight: what/why/confidence/override/disclaimer. Never silently rewrites the itinerary.

steps.purpose: Get from one stop to the next.
steps.rule: Offline is first-class: cached map, directions queued. Connectivity on islands is the norm, not the exception.
Edited offline is legal — the itinerary merges on reconnect with conflict markers. AI suggestions are additions, never replacements.

offlineCorrectness: The itinerary must work in full offline (island reality). Every edit stores locally; conflicts surface as markers, never silent overwrites. AI never edits — it proposes.
